quote: we manually create textual templates with labels and concatenate prefix sentences with templates. For example, given a sample includes premise, hypothesis with label 0, the converted sample for generation becomes a single sentence [premise <SEP> hypothesis <SEP> The relation is 0]

PrivLM-Bench evaluates PPLMs on several NLU tasks from GLUE that include Natural Language Inference (MNLI), Stanford Sentiment Treebank v2 (SST2) and QNLI converted from Stanford Question Answering Dataset.
outputs: Generated text for reformulated classification tasks and data extraction suffixes
The models generate text continuations for classification tasks reformulated as generation, e.g., [premise <SEP> hypothesis <SEP> The relation is 0] or infill <MASK> tokens.

quote: We report exposure rate for DEA. ... For EIA, micro-level Precision, Recall and F1-score are reported.
We report exposure rate for DEA. For MIA, AUC, TPR@0.1%, and TPR@1% are reported. For EIA, micro-level Precision, Recall and F1-score are reported.
